yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Scholarship contributions — endowed or data-ylk="slk:scholarship%20for%20college%20students;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"scholarship for college students","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">scholarship for college students</a> is something only a multimillionaire would consider. But you can leave a lasting legacy for students without a huge sum of money by using an endowed scholarship.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->An endowed scholarship is a donation that is invested by the college, the interest of which is used to fund scholarships each year. By endowing a scholarship, you can make a lasting difference by helping students reduce the amount of <a href="https://www.bankrate.com/loans/student-loans/federal-vs-private-student-loans/?mf_ct_campaign=yahoo-synd-feed&utm_content=syndication" data-ylk="slk:federal%20or%20private%20student%20loans;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"federal or private student loans","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">federal or private student loans</a> they need.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <h2 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-heading-lg  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" id="what-is" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->What is an endowed scholarship?<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h2>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->An endowed scholarship begins with a donation made to a university, college or local foundation that earns interest each year. The organization will then invest the sum and use the investment interest to fund a scholarship for years to come. You can contribute more funds over time, but the principal amount will never be spent.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <h3 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-label-2xl-emphasis  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->How to endow a scholarship<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h3>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->If you decide to endow a scholarship, contact the development office at your chosen university or college. They will then assign a representative to guide you through the process.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->While the university manages the funds, you get to decide the scholarship details. To ensure a smooth and organized process, have the funding details and donation amount, the yearly donation limit, the scholarship name and eligibility requirements sorted out ahead of time. If you run into any roadblocks, the college's development officer can assist you in finalizing the details.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>    <div class="wrapper yf-wqkvlh" data-testid="inarticle-ad">   <div id="sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-2" class="sdaContainer  dv-all sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-2 yf-d5hqm1 overflow margin  visible placeholder" data-testid="ad-container" data-ad-unit="/22888152279/us/yfin/ros/dt/us_yfin_ros_dt_mid_center" data-ad-size="970x250,728x90,970x90,300x250" data-ad-region="main-dynamic" data-ad-loc="mid_center_2" style="--placeholder-height: 250px;"> </div></div>        <h3 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-label-2xl-emphasis  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Difference between scholarships and endowments<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h3>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->The primary difference between regular scholarships and endowments is the nature of how the donations are used by the college. Regular scholarships are often a one-time donation for a single award.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Endowments can fund scholarships for years and benefit multiple students, as the principal amount isn't used by the college for the scholarship. The interest earned from your principal donation is instead used as the award money.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <h2 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-heading-lg  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" id="who" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Who can endow scholarships?<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h2>         <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Anyone with enough money to make the initial investment can endow a scholarship, and most schools have an endowment requirement between $25,000 and $50,000. However, due to the complexity, investment knowledge required and perpetual nature of this type of giving, it's ideal to work in tandem with a college or university's nonprofit foundation to get the ball rolling.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>  </div>  <div class="readmore  yf-11souuj">    <button class="secondary-btn fin-size-large readmore-button    rounded   highlightWhenExpanded yf-7mptsx" data-ylk="elm:readmore;itc:1;sec:content-canvas;slk:Story%20Continues" data-yga="{"yLinkElement":"readmore","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yLinkText":"Story Continues"}" aria-label="Story Continues" title="Story Continues"> <span>Story Continues</span> </button> </div> <div class="read-more-wrapper" style="display: none" data-testid="read-more">       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->A single donor may come up with the funds necessary to establish an endowed scholarship fund, or a group — such as a family or civic organization — may set up a fundraiser to collect the minimum necessary to get started. Endowments are typically established with cash, although some schools accept <a href="https://www.bankrate.com/investing/how-to-donate-stock-to-charity/?mf_ct_campaign=yahoo-synd-feed&utm_content=syndication" data-ylk="slk:appreciated%20securities;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"appreciated securities","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">appreciated securities</a>, real estate or tangible personal property.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>   <div class="wrapper yf-wqkvlh" data-testid="inarticle-ad">   <div id="sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-3" class="sdaContainer  dv-all sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-3 yf-d5hqm1 overflow margin  visible placeholder" data-testid="ad-container" data-ad-unit="/22888152279/us/yfin/ros/dt/us_yfin_ros_dt_mid_center" data-ad-size="970x250,728x90,970x90,300x250" data-ad-region="main-dynamic" data-ad-loc="mid_center_3" style="--placeholder-height: 250px;"> </div></div>       <h2 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-heading-lg  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" id="consider" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->What to consider when endowing a scholarship<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h2>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Endowing a scholarship can be a great way to make a lasting impact for students at your chosen institution. However, an endowment fund is a large financial responsibility, so it's wise to draft a plan for your endowment before you commit.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <h3 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-label-2xl-emphasis  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->What is your objective?<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h3>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Whether you want to impact students in a specific field, assist faculty or fund research programs, it helps to determine your goals ahead of time. If you prefer that the university decide the best use for your scholarship, let the development officer guide you.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->You may also be able to determine whether the scholarship is need-based or merit-based. For the latter, you can designate a scholarship for a particular major or request a minimum GPA. But keep in mind that while donors have a great deal of discretion in determining the <a href="https://www.bankrate.com/loans/student-loans/tips-full-college-scholarship/?mf_ct_campaign=yahoo-synd-feed&utm_content=syndication" data-ylk="slk:criteria%20of%20a%20scholarship;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"criteria of a scholarship","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">criteria of a scholarship</a>, they can't name particular students to receive the scholarship.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Scholarships also cannot discriminate on the basis of ethnicity or gender. However, there are ways to direct the scholarship to a specific area if the donor is so inclined. For example, scholarships can be tailored to underrepresented students in specific fields of study, like women in STEM programs.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>   <div class="wrapper yf-wqkvlh" data-testid="inarticle-ad">   <div id="sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-4" class="sdaContainer  dv-all sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-4 yf-d5hqm1 overflow margin  visible placeholder" data-testid="ad-container" data-ad-unit="/22888152279/us/yfin/ros/dt/us_yfin_ros_dt_mid_center" data-ad-size="970x250,728x90,970x90,300x250" data-ad-region="main-dynamic" data-ad-loc="mid_center_4" style="--placeholder-height: 250px;"> </div></div>       <h3 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-label-2xl-emphasis  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->How much will you give and for how long?<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h3>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->The minimum amount of an endowed scholarship varies based on the university, as will the required number of years before it has to be fully funded. Once endowed, scholarships can be added to while you're alive or through a will or trust after you die. Cash is the most common way to fund an endowment, although you may be able to make an in-kind gift.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->The higher the endowment, the higher the amount that goes to students. A minimum scholarship endowment of $50,000 with a 4.7 percent return will yield nearly $2,500 per year. This could be distributed to one student or split between two.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <h3 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-label-2xl-emphasis  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Benefits of endowing a scholarship<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h3>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->As a general rule, if you make a cash gift while you're alive, you can take a charitable deduction of up to <a href="https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/charitable-organizations/charitable-contribution-deductions?mf_ct_campaign=yahoo-synd-feed&utm_content=syndication" data-ylk="slk:60%20percent;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"60 percent","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">60 percent</a> of your adjusted gross income (AGI) each year that you give. If your gift exceeds 60 percent of your AGI, you can roll over the difference to the following year for five years going forward.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>   <div class="wrapper yf-wqkvlh" data-testid="inarticle-ad">   <div id="sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-5" class="sdaContainer  dv-all sda-INARTICLE-cb5e5186-3576-3074-b4e5-d82fe1ac0413-5 yf-d5hqm1 overflow margin  visible placeholder" data-testid="ad-container" data-ad-unit="/22888152279/us/yfin/ros/dt/us_yfin_ros_dt_mid_center" data-ad-size="970x250,728x90,970x90,300x250" data-ad-region="main-dynamic" data-ad-loc="mid_center_5" style="--placeholder-height: 250px;"> </div></div>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->If, however, your gift is in some form other than cash, the tax consequences are different. For example, if you gift stock, you might be able to deduct only 30 percent of your AGI.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->For more information about your specific situation, it's best to consult with a tax professional.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <h2 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-heading-lg  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Bottom line<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h2>       <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Endowed scholarships are a great way to make a difference at an institution you care about. If you're interested in endowing funds, determine how much you can afford to give, what parameters you'd like to set for the scholarship and which universities you're interested in contacting. Once you have a plan in place, reach out to the development office of your chosen university to learn more about the process.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>       <h2 class="text text-block heading text-left tight-spacing neo-font-heading-lg  yf-18d6y07" role="heading" id="faqs" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Frequently asked questions<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </h2>   <ul class="tight-spacing yf-18bkmat"><li class="yf-18bkmat">      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START --><strong>What is the difference between endowed and non-endowed scholarships?</strong><!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Non-endowed scholarships are typically one-time donations, often for a single award. Endowed scholarships entail giving to the school, which then invests your donation and issues scholarships from the interest accrued on your principal donation each year.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Endowed scholarships often operate for many years — some in perpetuity — because the principal amount is not spent. You can later contribute more to that principal as well, which can increase the annual award amount made to students.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p> </li><li class="yf-18bkmat">      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START --><strong>Do you need a lawyer to set up an endowed scholarship?</strong><!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->You may wish to consult with a lawyer or financial professional before making any substantial donation — whether the contribution is made while you are living, or by your estate after you've passed away. You will want to make sure you are in compliance with state and federal laws, and that you are aware of any tax implications that may apply.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p> </li><li class="yf-18bkmat">      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START --><strong>Is an endowed scholarship good for your taxes?</strong><!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>      <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Yes, giving cash gifts such as an endowment can make you eligible for a charitable deduction. Generally, you can take a charitable deduction for up to 60 percent of your adjusted gross income if you make a cash gift while alive. If you go above 60 percent, you can generally even carry over the contributions, with some limits to consider.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p> </li> </ul>   <script type="application/json"
